stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: 30 pts from Doug Sutton, a round that would poll three votes in any grandstand in the country.

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 48 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - level with the lead with 4 to play

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga, Jordan Simpson from North West Bay GC, and thanks for keeping it in play.

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 2 & 3 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 6 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 14, 3-pointer on hole 15 - that's better

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Carl Ryder went 5th to 19th, a wobble the coaching staff will quietly file away for later.

stories.title: In the Wet
stories.detail: 2.8 soaked the lot of them and the scoreboard has the proof.

stories.title: Away-Day Raid
stories.detail: Nudgee GC making the trip count - 11th on the board
